name: terraform
description: The Terraform provider for Pulumi lets you consume the outputs contained in Terraform state from your Pulumi programs.

name.description: The full name of one remote workspace. When configured, only the default workspace can be used. This option conflicts with prefix.

prefix.description: A prefix used in the names of one or more remote workspaces, all of which can be used with this configuration. The full workspace names are used in HCP Terraform, and the short names (minus the prefix) are used on the command line for Terraform CLI workspaces. If omitted, only the default workspace can be used. This option conflicts with name.

terraform:state:getAzureRMReference.description: Access state stored in an Azure Blob Storage container.

accessKey.description: The access key of the storage account. Falls back to the ARM_ACCESS_KEY environment variable when unset.

clientCertificatePassword.description: The password for the client certificate specified in clientCertificatePath. Falls back to the ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD environment variable when unset.

clientCertificatePath.description: The path to the PFX file used as the client certificate for service principal authentication. Falls back to the ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH environment variable when unset.

clientId.description: The client ID to authenticate as. Falls back to the ARM_CLIENT_ID environment variable when unset.

clientSecret.description: The client secret used for service principal authentication. Falls back to the ARM_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable when unset.

containerName.description: The name of the storage container within the storage account.

endpoint.description: A custom endpoint for the Azure Resource Manager API. Falls back to the ARM_ENDPOINT environment variable when unset.

environment.description: The Azure cloud environment to use: public (default), china, german, stack or usgovernment. Falls back to the ARM_ENVIRONMENT environment variable when unset.

key.description: The name of the blob holding the Terraform state file inside the storage container.

metadataHost.description: The hostname of the Azure metadata service used to obtain the cloud environment. Falls back to the ARM_METADATA_HOST environment variable when unset.

msiEndpoint.description: The endpoint of the Managed Service Identity. Falls back to the ARM_MSI_ENDPOINT environment variable when unset.

oidcRequestToken.description: The bearer token for requests to the oidcRequestUrl URL. Falls back to the ARM_OIDC_REQUEST_TOKEN or ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN environment variables when unset.

oidcRequestUrl.description: The URL of the OIDC provider to request an ID token from, e.g. in GitHub Actions. Requires oidcRequestToken. Falls back to the ARM_OIDC_REQUEST_URL or ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL environment variables when unset.

oidcToken.description: A JWT token for OIDC authentication. Conflicts with oidcRequestToken. Falls back to the ARM_OIDC_TOKEN environment variable when unset.

oidcTokenFilePath.description: The path to a file containing a JWT token for OIDC authentication. Conflicts with oidcRequestToken. Falls back to the ARM_OIDC_TOKEN_FILE_PATH environment variable when unset.

resourceGroupName.description: The name of the resource group holding the storage account. Required when using AzureAD authentication against the Azure Resource Manager API to look up the storage access key.

sasToken.description: A SAS token for accessing the storage container. Falls back to the ARM_SAS_TOKEN environment variable when unset.

storageAccountName.description: The name of the storage account.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription ID holding the storage account. Falls back to the ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable when unset.

tenantId.description: The tenant ID to authenticate against. Falls back to the ARM_TENANT_ID environment variable when unset.

useAzureadAuth.description: Whether to authenticate against the storage container with AzureAD instead of an access key. Falls back to the ARM_USE_AZUREAD environment variable when unset.

useMsi.description: Whether to authenticate using Managed Service Identity. Falls back to the ARM_USE_MSI environment variable when unset.

useOidc.description: Whether to authenticate using OIDC. Falls back to the ARM_USE_OIDC environment variable when unset.

workspace.description: The Terraform workspace to read state from.

outputs.description: The result of fetching from a Terraform state store.
The outputs displayed from Terraform state.

terraform:state:getLocalReference.description: Access state from the local filesystem.

path.description: The path to the tfstate file. This defaults to "terraform.tfstate" relative to the root module by default.

outputs.description: The result of fetching from a Terraform state store.
The outputs displayed from Terraform state.

terraform:state:getRemoteReference.description: Access state from a remote backend.

hostname.description: The remote backend hostname to connect to.

organization.description: The name of the organization containing the targeted workspace(s).

token.description: The token used to authenticate with the remote backend.

outputs.description: The result of fetching from a Terraform state store.
The outputs displayed from Terraform state.

terraform:state:getS3Reference.description: Access state from an AWS S3 bucket.

bucket.description: The name of the S3 bucket.

encrypt.description: Whether to enable server side encryption of the state file.

endpoint.description: A custom endpoint for the S3 API.

forcePathStyle.description: Force s3 to use path-style addressing instead of virtual hosted-bucket addressing. Required by most S3-compatible stores.

iamEndpoint.description: A custom endpoint for the IAM API.

key.description: The path to the state file inside the bucket. When using a non-default workspace, the state path is /workspace_key_prefix/workspace_name/key.

kmsKeyId.description: The ARN of a KMS Key to use for encrypting the state.

maxRetries.description: The maximum number of times an AWS API request is retried on retryable failure.

profile.description: AWS profile name as set in the shared credentials file.

region.description: AWS region of the S3 bucket. Falls back to the AWS_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION environment variables when unset.

sharedCredentialsFile.description: Path to a shared credentials file.

skipCredentialsValidation.description: Skip the credentials validation via the STS API.

skipMetadataApiCheck.description: Skip the AWS Metadata API check.

skipRegionValidation.description: Skip static validation of region name.

sseCustomerKey.description: The base64-encoded encryption key to use for server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C).

stsEndpoint.description: A custom endpoint for the STS API.

workspace.description: The Terraform workspace to read state from.

workspaceKeyPrefix.description: The prefix applied to the non-default state path inside the bucket.

outputs.description: The result of fetching from a Terraform state store.
The outputs displayed from Terraform state.
